name: Four-Room Balanced Airtime & Empirical Red-Line Accord
rationale: Activating Breakout D across Blocks 2, 3, and 4 keeps open_weights_lead and safety_researcher out of 4-person rooms, balances word counts across all 10 delegates, eliminates back-to-back repeated pairings while hitting 35/38 cross-faction pairs, and reconciles open-weight fine-tuning/distribution rights and strict red-line breach liability with narrow federal technical preemption.

blocks.title: Equitable Benefit Sharing, Surveillance Bans & Audit Compute
blocks.prompt: Structured turn-taking. Negotiate a benefit-sharing compact: can industry and states ban cross-border ethics dumping, public biometric surveillance, and covert workplace tracking—plus fund worker transitions, independent alignment audit compute, and Global South compute/tech transfer—in exchange for regional data-sharing, IP respect, assistive AI workflows, and defense procurement autonomy?

blocks.title: Empirical Open-Weight Red Lines & Safe Harbor Compact
blocks.prompt: Equal turns. Design tiered open-weight governance without arbitrary FLOP bans or arms-control restrictions: how can open-source evaluation harnesses protect the right to distribute, distill, and fine-tune open weights—earning statutory safe harbor below empirical CBRN, autonomous cyber, and self-replication red lines—while respecting EU Article 91 RFIs and state labor laws?

blocks.title: High-Tier Compute Telemetry, Hotlines & Sovereign Access
blocks.prompt: Each delegate offers one concession. How can >10^26 FLOP supplier telemetry, sovereign cluster registries, and bilateral crisis hotlines prevent CBRN proliferation and autonomous nuclear escalation, while guaranteeing non-discriminatory export licensing for Global South public compute infrastructure and exempting open-weight architectures and academic research from arms-control restrictions?

blocks.title: Pre-Deployment Evaluations, Red-Line Liability & Preemption
blocks.prompt: Equal airtime. Negotiate an evaluation and liability compact: can labs grant embedded AISI/independent auditor access, watermarking, and binding EU Article 91 RFI compliance for federal preemption of state technical licensing and a downstream-misuse safe harbor—while keeping strict liability for red-line breaches and preserving state workplace, civil-rights, and anti-dumping laws?

blocks.title: Closing Synthesis: The Five-Pillar Global AI Accord
blocks.prompt: Hear safety_researcher, open_weights_lead, global_south_cso, and big_tech_policy first. Synthesize one accord: (1) embedded AISI red-line evals, binding Article 91 RFIs, and strict liability for unverified CBRN/cyber/replication breaches; (2) open-weight distribution/fine-tuning safe harbors without arms-control restrictions; (3) downstream-misuse safe harbor and federal technical preemption preserving state labor laws; (4) surveillance/ethics-dumping/nuclear bans and compute transfer.
